blend_numeric.txt SHA256:
bac6046fd6c25da19d3c5463a34098a0d405209efd5f84eb3103433dda02d358
623 records: RECON=100, PARITY=400, ORIENT=120, SIGN=2, FINITE=1.
Schema: kind|k0|k1|lambda bits|start derivative bits|end derivative bits|
control bits|requested endpoint derivative bits. All double bits: 16 hex digits.
Reconstruction targets preserve original Python lambda**j multiplication order.
Independent Rust Bernstein sums retain original scalar summation order and
1e-10 * max(1, abs(actual), abs(expected)) criterion, never widened.
100 recon records cover each of the 25 order pairs four times, 600 derivative
vectors / 1800 scalar comparisons, including negative and zero speed scales.
Every one of the 623 numeric records is replayed both through the Rust C ABI
and through BOTH Python public wrapper and ctypes binding, not sampled.
No HOST-tagged records are omitted (this capture has no separate HOST kind).
